csharpCode: string sourcePath = "Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity"; string destPath = "Assets/Scenes/MainMenuScene.unity"; if (UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.CopyAsset(sourcePath, destPath)) { var scene = UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(destPath); string[] objectsToDelete = new string[] { "TrackingManager", "MissArea", "AudioReactionSystem", "NoteSpawner", "ScoreManager", "UICanvas", "GameManager" }; foreach (var name in objectsToDelete) { GameObject go = GameObject.Find(name); if (go != null) { GameObject.DestroyImmediate(go); } } UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene); Debug.Log("[Setup] MainMenuScene created by copying SampleScene and stripping gameplay track successfully."); } else { Debug.LogError("[Setup] Failed to copy SampleScene to MainMenuScene."); }
